params.name: n_d / n_a
params.why: Width of the decision and attention outputs (f4). Small: 28k rows cannot support a wide network.

params.name: n_steps
params.why: Number of decision steps (N_steps). 3–8 is typical; 4 keeps the mask heatmap readable.

params.name: gamma
params.why: Prior-scale relaxation (f2): >1 lets a feature be reused in later steps.

params.name: cat_emb_dim
params.why: Each categorical level becomes a learned 2-d vector instead of a one-hot column.

params.name: optimizer
params.why: The paper's recommended setup for small tabular data.

params.name: max_epochs / patience
params.why: Early stopping on validation AUC; stopped after 70 epochs.

params.name: batch_size / virtual_batch_size
params.why: Ghost batch normalisation: statistics over 128-row virtual batches.

params.name: weights
params.why: Balanced sampling of training batches: the 11.27% minority is drawn as often as the majority.

params.name: seed
params.why: Fixes weight initialisation and batch order.
